description: This file defines the DriverPlugin interface for Spark plugins, including lifecycle methods such as init, registerMetrics, receive, and shutdown.

classes.name: DriverPlugin
classes.description: Interface for Spark driver plugins, providing lifecycle hooks and RPC handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin early in Spark driver startup, returning a map for executor plugins.

methods.name: registerMetrics
methods.description: Registers plugin metrics with Spark's metrics system after application ID is known.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Handles RPC messages sent from executors to the driver; can throw exceptions.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Informs the plugin that the Spark application is shutting down.
